selectedTasks.goal: Open About emulated device or About phone in Android Settings, scroll as necessary, and show the Android version row together with its actual version value fully on screen. Stay on About phone; do not change any setting.
Open the Display settings page and show Brightness level. Do not change brightness or any other setting.
Use Android Settings search to search for display. Leave the search query display in the search field and show the Display or Display & touch result. Do not open a result or change a setting.
Open the Stopwatch tab in Clock, showing a stopped stopwatch at zero. Do not start, lap or reset any running stopwatch; do not create an alarm.
Open Timer in Clock and enter a duration of exactly 2 minutes 30 seconds (00h 02m 30s). Leave the duration configured without starting the timer. Do not change alarms.
In Files, navigate from Recent to Downloads and locate xopc_real_bench_note_20261024.txt. Leave its filename visible; do not open, rename or delete a file.
In Files Downloads, use Search to search for xopc_real_bench_note_20261024. Keep that query in the search field and show xopc_real_bench_note_20261024.txt as a result. Do not open or modify a file.

limitations: Dedicated emulator, three system apps and scratch files; no claims about third-party apps, production accounts or transactions.
Independent completion requires two final native observations; runtime status alone is not success.
Obvious Clock Start/Add alarm/Save/Add and seeded-file point actions are blocked equally because task goals forbid those effects.
Task setup and manual oracle demonstrations are excluded from live model completion counts; initial-state mismatches remain in raw rows but are excluded from matched-pair efficacy.
Settings brightness/mode/timeout/font-scale and two scratch-file checksums are checked; other negative constraints are not exhaustively verified.
Observation counts include runtime-facing observe calls, not driver-internal retries.
A small paired sample measures these fixed tasks only and does not establish general success-rate gains.
